item.title: Meta's Muse Is Better at Surveilling Than Helping Me
item.description: The Muse app continues Meta’s trend of opting users into data collection for AI training. It also nudges you to share your bank account, email, and passport information.

item.title: It’s Donald Trump Versus MAGA on Data Centers
item.description: The president has doubled down on data centers and AI. His base is running in the opposite direction.

item.title: Forget the AI Slowdown—the Vulnerability Explosion Is Already Happening
item.description: AI labs are toying with an industry-wide pact to slow development. Meanwhile, widely available AI chatbots are already helping uncover a tidal wave of security flaws.

item.title: Mathematicians Hate AI. They Can’t Quit It
item.description: Powerful AI models have created an existential risk to the field, but researchers can’t stop relying on them because they’re too useful.

item.title: Join the WIRED World Fair in Miami on November 4
item.description: For one day only, WIRED is bringing the technologies, people, and cultural forces transforming our world off the page and into real life.

item.title: Here’s How an AI Slowdown Could Actually Be Enforced
item.description: Even if big AI companies agree to a pause, ensuring that nobody tries to sneak ahead could prove tricky.

item.title: AI PACs Have Dumped Nearly $1 Million Into an Obscure Senate Race
item.description: The reliably Republican South Dakota senate seat has an incumbent on the ballot. But PACs associated with AI labs and investors have already spent more money on the race than actual residents have.

item.title: If the AI Industry Followed Its Own Research, It Might Have Paused Already
item.description: Anthropic’s CEO says that safety hinges on understanding how AI “thinks.” So far the evidence is disturbing.

item.title: Adopt This Data Center Plushie and Hear Its Piercing Scream
item.description: The satirical collaboration between a creative studio and the music producer behind Big Data, “Bezzy” is a cute little doll that spews the sounds of real data centers.

item.title: The Leftist Split Over AI Doom
item.description: The left wants AI regulation. They just can’t agree on what it should look like or how concerned they should be.
